decisions.target_truth: Keep physical/chemical atom and nontechnical tiny-particle/trace use; both are coherent and useful.

Keep attach/join/add one thing to another as the primary center, plus attach importance/value to, emotional be attached to, and lower affiliation/belonging use. Remove the duplicate secondary_sense for importance/value and collapse duplicate construction objects already representing the same attach-to patterns.

Keep broad verb/noun attack as the ordinary center, covering physical attack and extended criticism where licensed. Retain attack↔assault only with a corrected boundary: assault is typically stronger and especially physical/legal, while attack is broader. Do not claim a shared speech/writing sense while anchoring assault to a violent-attack sense.
Keep attain=achieve after effort and attain=reach an age/level/state; the collocational distinction is learner-useful.
Keep verb attempt and noun attempt. Represent attempt to do / attempt sth once as the verb's governing pattern rather than duplicating the same learner object as an extra construction.

Center attend=be present at and attend to=give attention/deal with/care for. Fold formal attend a patient into the care branch and downgrade attended by=accompanied by as lower recognition. Do not duplicate attend to as both an Active sense pattern and a separate equivalent construction.

Keep attendant=person whose job is to help/serve, and lower attendee/present-person or present adjective where useful. Remove deprecated accompanying/consequent meaning from Core/Word Feel; it must not define the active learner center after deprecation.

Center attention=focused notice/mental concentration and general public notice/interest as one compact family. Preserve pay attention to and draw/call attention to as high-value structures without multiplying the same object. Downgrade courteous/affectionate attentions to recognition.

Restore attitude toward/to=way of thinking/feeling/viewpoint as the primary Active sense. Keep aerospace attitude=orientation as specialized recognition and theatrical pose only as lower recognition. Current v4 state incorrectly deprecates the ordinary sense while leaving peripheral senses Active.
Keep attorney=lawyer/legal representative, with defense attorney and Attorney General as useful lexicalized contexts.
Keep figurative attract interest/people and physical attract/pull by force as two coherent branches.

Use one ordinary evaluative center attractive=appealing/interesting/desirable rather than splitting beauty/charm from ability to arouse interest. Keep physical attractive force only as specialized recognition; retain the valid attract family relation.

Keep noun attribute=quality/feature and verb attribute A to B=regard A as caused by or belonging to B. Collapse duplicate attribute-to constructions. Rebind attributable to the verb attribution sense, not noun 'quality'. Re-anchor the attribute↔ascribe relation to the verb sense.
Keep noun auction and verb auction/auction off; both are ordinary and coherent.

Center audience as the people who watch, listen to, read, or otherwise receive content, including target audience. Avoid unnecessary separate reader-only sense; readership is a neighboring lexical item, not a collocation of audience.
Keep noun audio and adjective audio; both share the recorded/transmitted sound center and are ordinary modern uses.

Restore noun audit=systematic examination/review and verb audit=perform such an examination as separate noun/verb learner branches. Keep American audit a course=attend without credit as a distinct lower branch. Do not merge verb senses across POS into the noun sense.
Single ordinary noun for the audience seating area/large hall is correct and sufficient.
Use one semantic center augment=increase/enlarge/strengthen; represent transitive make larger and rarer intransitive become larger as argument-structure differences rather than separate equal senses.
Preserve case-sensitive August=month and lower-frequency august=majestic/dignified. Current lexical-identity overlay adequately marks the month identity.

relation_truth.target_truth: Preserve the useful broad-vs-stronger contrast, but align source/target sense evidence and wording. Attack is broad and can be physical or verbal/critical; assault is especially violent physical/legal attack, with figurative uses only where genuinely licensed.
The lexical contrast is useful, but the source must be verb attribute A to B, not noun attribute=quality. Re-anchor source_sense_id to the verb attribution sense before publication.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
Cross-POS merges and relation sense-anchor errors are hard Knowledge defects even when surface boundary prose sounds plausible.
